title: Misconceptions, Pragmatism, and Value Tensions: Evaluating Students’ Understanding and Perception of Generative AI for Education
reasoning: The paper investigates student perceptions of ethical issues as a primary research objective (Survey Question 4). It includes a dedicated findings section (IV.D) and a summary table (Table II) that analyze ethical concerns such as plagiarism, academic integrity, copyright infringement, and bias. This constitutes a substantial component of the research rather than a standard boilerplate 'Ethical Considerations' section.
